title: Quadratic character pair tester
statement: For each $n\ge 0$, consider the tester obtained by choosing uniformly among three testers: the linear BLR tester, the matrix BLR tester, and the rank-one tester. The chosen tester is run on addresses that are either vectors in $\mathbb F_2^n$ or $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$, with answers in $\mathbb F_2$ and four query positions.
hypotheses_covered: Uniform choice among three component testers
caveat: The formal statement refers to the linear and matrix BLR component testers, whose definitions are not included in the supplied material.
